Reptile_2026-08-17_gcc13_x64_cmd.notes: The userland half only. kernel/ is a .ko and is not built: a relocatable kernel object has no program headers and every section at address 0, so SMDA has no layout to work from and either finds nothing or attaches names to the wrong bodies - see the not-built table, where this is recorded in full. The four binaries here are ordinary dynamically linked PIE executables; upstream's Makefile comments describe shell and cmd as the pair that stays on the victim machine and listener and packet as the attacker's. Counts: shell 32/27, cmd 11/8, listener 56/45, packet 29/17 symbol-carrying functions on x86/x64, with cmd x64 exactly on the eight-function floor, which is the project's own size. AUTH and HTUA are pinned rather than taken from /dev/urandom, the only departure from upstream's build path: both are visibly synthetic (ASCII Rept and ile!) so they are not mistaken for observed values, and the functions comparing against them will not match a real sample's, which carries that actor's random pair.
